book.not_enough_sigils.guide.altar.ascen: The Ascended Ara Vitae
Two tiers beyond the Transcendent altar.
Beyond Transcendence

The Transcendent altar was never the summit. Those who master all five [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() and wrest the rarest stones from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]() may raise the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() two tiers higher.\
\
Both tiers keep the full Tier 5 structure. Pillar bodies are optional; only runes and capstones are checked.

[#](B8860B)Tier 6[#]() adds a ring of runes with radius 14, one level below the previous ring. Pillars rise from that ring at the four diagonals, crowned by one [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystal Cluster[#]() of each kind: [#](2E8B57)Ruina[#](), [#](B8860B)Nihilum[#](), [#](4A0080)Invictus[#]() and [#](8B0000)Vindicta[#]().
Tier 6 Ara Vitae
260 total runes. The four Spiritus answer as one.

[#](B8860B)Tier 7[#]() adds a final ring of runes with radius 17, another level down. Twelve-block pillars rise at the cardinals, capped with [#](8B0000)Sanguine Deus Blocks[#](), while [#](8B0000)Prismatic Demonite[#]() anchors the four diagonals on the outer ring.
Tier 7 Ara Vitae
372 total runes. A shrine fit for the divine.

book.not_enough_sigils.guide.sigils.intr: How every new sigil is made.

Every sigil in this book is born in two steps. First a [#](8B0000)Reagent[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#](), then the reagent is bound to a [#](8B0000)Tabula[#]() inside an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
Sigils drain [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from your Soul Network, just like the sigils of Neo Vitae.

[#](B8860B)Reagents[#]()\
Place the four ingredients in the Hellfire Forge with a Spiritus gem holding enough Spiritus. Each recipe page shows the minimum Spiritus required and how much is drained.\
\
Toggled sigils pay their upkeep every 5 seconds while active. Sneak and use a toggled sigil to switch it on or off.

[#](B8860B)Alchemy Arrays[#]()\
Draw an array with the [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#](), then use the reagent and the matching Tabula on it. The array consumes both and leaves the finished sigil.\
\
Bind the sigil to yourself before use, so it knows which network to drain.

Each rebirth drains 1,000 EV.

book.not_enough_sigils.guide.upgrades.in: Greater sigils born in the Ara Vitae.

A sigil that has served you well can be pushed beyond its limits. Lay it upon the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() and let the altar pour [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into it until it awakens in a greater form.\
\
Most of these rites demand the [#](B8860B)ascended tiers[#]() of the altar, described in the Ascended Altar chapter.

[#](B8860B)Upgrading[#]()\
The upgraded sigil keeps the binding of the original. Each recipe page shows the required altar tier and the total EV the craft consumes.\
\
Runes of Eternity in the altar reduce these costs.

book.not_enough_sigils.guide.altar.blood: Blood orbs for the ascended tiers.

As the altar ascends, so must the vessel of your network. Two new [#](8B0000)Blood Orbs[#]() are forged from the greatest Spiritus gems, each raising the limit of your [#](4A0080)Soul Network[#]() far beyond the Transcendent orb.\
\
Like every orb, they must be bound to you and filled at the altar.

[#](B8860B)Ascensus Orb of Vitae[#]()\
Forged in a Tier 6 altar from an [#](8B0000)Exalted Spiritus Gem[#](). Raises your network to 75 million EV.

[#](B8860B)Aeternus Orb of Vitae[#]()\
Forged in a Tier 7 altar from a [#](8B0000)Primordial Spiritus Gem[#](). Its blood never rests, and it raises your network to 200 million EV.
book.not_enough_sigils.guide.altar.ascen: Ascended Runes
Runes that awaken only in the ascended tiers.
Ascended Runes

Some runes are too potent for a lesser altar. [#](B8860B)Ascended Runes[#]() count as normal runes for the structure, but their power only awakens in a [#](8B0000)Tier 6[#]() altar or higher.\
\
They are crafted from their Reinforced counterparts, wrapped in netherite, hellforged parts and Deus shards.

[#](B8860B)Ascended Augmented Capacity Rune[#]()\
Multiplies the altar's capacity even further than the Reinforced Augmented Capacity Rune. Stack them and the altar's tank grows exponentially.

[#](B8860B)Ascended Speed Rune[#]()\
Greatly increases the altar's crafting speed and also hastens its transfer rate.

[#](B8860B)Rune of Eternity[#]()\
Each rune reduces the blood cost of every Ara Vitae recipe by 2%, up to a 50% reduction.
book.not_enough_sigils.guide.spiritus.as: Spiritus gems beyond the Grand gem.

The [#](8B0000)Grand Spiritus Gem[#]() is not the end of the road. Forged with Deus shards and nether stars, two greater gems can hold far more [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]().\
\
They work like any other gem: carried, worn as a necklace or socketed into sentient gear.

[#](B8860B)Exalted Spiritus Gem[#]()\
Holds up to 32,768 Spiritus. Forged from a Grand gem.

[#](B8860B)Primordial Spiritus Gem[#]()\
Holds up to 65,536 Spiritus. Forged from an Exalted gem.
book.not_enough_sigils.guide.spiritus.sp: Sigils that answer to your Spiritus.

Several sigils draw on the [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() you carry. The more you hold, and the kind that dominates, decide how they behave.\
\
Your dominant Spiritus is the type you hold the most of across all your gems.

- [#](8B0000)Magician[#]() and [#](8B0000)Archmage[#](): missile damage grows with stored Spiritus; its type shapes the missile.\
- [#](8B0000)Demon Ninja[#](): the type decides the knife's element.\
- [#](8B0000)Spiritual Monk[#](): the type shapes your punches.\
- [#](8B0000)Reaper[#](): kills feed your gems.
book.not_enough_sigils.guide.saereth.rit: Summons Saereth, author of Neo Vitae.

A tribute to [#](8B0000)Saereth[#](), author of Neo Vitae. This ritual calls the Archivist himself to stand upon the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), and leaves behind the [#](B8860B)Sigil of Soul Capture[#]().\
\
Saereth is a tireless scribe: given ingredients and an Arcane Scribe Tool, he draws alchemy arrays and crafts everything for you.

[#](8B0000)Activation Cost:[#]() 50,000 EV\
[#](8B0000)Crystal:[#]() Weak Activation Crystal\
\
[#](8B0000)Rune Requirements:[#]()\
  8x Tenebrae Ritual Stone\
  8x Water Ritual Stone\
  4x Fire Ritual Stone\
  4x Earth Ritual Stone\
  4x Air Ritual Stone\
  [#](8B0000)Total:[#]() 28 runes
book.not_enough_sigils.guide.saereth.sig:
The sigil left by the ritual is how you speak with Saereth. He only listens to the one who summoned him.\
\
Sneak and use the sigil in the air to clear any marked positions.

[#](B8860B)Linking[#]()\
1. Use the sigil on a [#](8B0000)chest[#]() to mark it.\
2. Use the sigil on the [#](8B0000)top face[#]() of a block to mark the array spot.\
3. Use the sigil on Saereth to hand him both positions.\
\
Both must be within 8 blocks of him and in the same dimension.

[#](B8860B)Capture and Release[#]()\
Sneak and use the sigil on Saereth to bind him inside it, keeping his links. Use the sigil on a block to release him there.\
\
More than one Saereth may serve you at once, each with his own ritual.
book.not_enough_sigils.guide.saereth.wor: Author of Neo Vitae, scribe of arrays.

Fill the linked chest with an [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#]() and the ingredients of any alchemy array recipe. Saereth takes them, draws the array on the marked spot and casts it.\
\
Results go back into the chest. If it is full, they are left on the ground.

[#](B8860B)Status[#]()\
Use an empty hand on Saereth to see what he is doing: waiting for links, ready, crafting, or what is stopping him, such as a missing scribe tool, a full chest or a blocked array spot.\
\
Server owners can tune his range and speed in the datapack file [#](8B0000)data/not_enough_sigils/saereth/settings.json[#]().

book.not_enough_sigils.guide.altar.progr: The materials that only the ascended altars can make.

Each ascended tier has a material that only it can create. These essences are the heart of every greater sigil and relic: without them, the higher rites cannot begin.\
\
The chain always starts with a [#](8B0000)Soul Fragment[#]().

[#](B8860B)Soul Fragment[#]()\
Dropped by creatures slain while the [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Reaper[#]() is active. Stronger foes and Looting improve the odds.\
\
Only creatures with at least 10 maximum health can yield a fragment.

[#](B8860B)Ascended Essence[#]()\
A Soul Fragment condensed in a [#](8B0000)Tier 6[#]() Ara Vitae. The base material of every Tier 6 creation.

[#](B8860B)Divine Essence[#]()\
An Ascended Essence purified in a [#](8B0000)Tier 7[#]() Ara Vitae. Reserved for the mightiest relics.

book.not_enough_sigils.guide.saereth.lib:
When there is no array to draw, Saereth turns to his archive. He looks in the linked chest for two [#](8B0000)identical enchanted books[#](), calls them out into the air and weaves them around himself in a ritual of blood and ink.\
\
The two books become one, every enchantment raised by one level, and the new tome drifts back into the chest.

[#](B8860B)Rules[#]()\
- Both books must hold exactly the same enchantments at the same levels.\
- Books keep growing up to level 255, even for vanilla enchantments.\
- Array crafts always come first.\
\
[#](8B0000)Cost:[#]() 1,000 EV from the owner's network for each level of the resulting book, paid when the books are bound.

[#](B8860B)Settings[#]()\
Modpacks can change the library in [#](8B0000)data/not_enough_sigils/saereth/settings.json[#]():\
- library_enabled\
- library_ev_per_level\
- library_max_level (255 by default; any value from 1 to 254 sets a lower cap)

book.not_enough_sigils.guide.rituals.bui: Excavates any area you mark, chunk by chunk.

Where the Endless Quarry hunts only ore, the [#](8B0000)Ritual of the Builder[#]() clears everything. It digs out every block inside the area you mark, layer by layer from the top, and sends every drop into a chest on top of the master stone.\
\
It needs an [#](B8860B)Awakened Activation Crystal[#](), forged in a Tier 4 Ara Vitae.

[#](B8860B)Marking the Area[#]()\
Use the [#](8B0000)Ritual Configurator[#]() on the master stone, pick the miningRange and mark its two corners in the world. There is no limit on the volume: mark a single room or a whole valley.\
\
The ritual works one chunk at a time and keeps that chunk loaded. It only moves on when the current chunk is empty, always staying inside your marked height, width and depth.

[#](B8860B)Mining[#]()\
In the Ritual Configurator, choose [#](8B0000)Silk Touch[#]() to keep blocks whole, or [#](8B0000)Fortune[#]() to mine with Fortune VIII.\
\
Drops go into the chest above the master stone (the chestRange can move it). When the chest is full the ritual pauses, so nothing is lost. When the whole area is clear, the ritual ends on its own.\
\
[#](8B0000)Cost:[#]() 25 EV per block, up to 8 blocks every 5 ticks.

[#](8B0000)Activation Cost:[#]() 30,000 EV\
[#](8B0000)Crystal:[#]() Awakened Activation Crystal\
